actions.title: Confirm trainer and session content
actions.description: Confirm the trainer, agenda and expected session format.
actions.fallback: Use an internal facilitator or agree a new session time.

actions.title: Confirm participant list
actions.description: Check the audience and make sure the right people are invited.
actions.fallback: Use the existing registration list and brief the trainer on any gaps.

actions.title: Confirm room or virtual meeting
actions.description: Make sure a suitable room or meeting link is available.
actions.fallback: Switch to an available alternative room or a virtual format.

actions.title: Check IT and presentation setup
actions.description: Confirm screen, audio, connection and access to the presentation.
actions.fallback: Use a laptop with a local copy of the materials and a simple screen-share fallback.

actions.title: Send a concise participant reminder
actions.description: Share the time, location or link and any short joining instructions.
actions.fallback: Send a short plain-text reminder with the essential joining details.

actions.title: Prepare session materials
actions.description: Make the presentation and handouts available to the trainer.
actions.fallback: Use the trainer's existing standard deck and skip new handouts.

actions.title: Prepare attendance and feedback follow-up
actions.description: Have a simple way to record attendance and collect feedback after the session.
actions.fallback: Record attendance after the session and send feedback later.
